label.translation: You can combine two or more face groups on a mesh body as long as they share a common edge.

label.devLabel: Combine Face Groups Information
Creates a sketch that contains a section line where a plane intersects a mesh body.
label.translation: Creates a sketch that contains a section line where a plane intersects a mesh body.

label.devLabel: Select a mesh body, select a plane, then adjust the location of the section line. Edit the sketch and use the Fit Curves To Mesh Section command to create sketch geometry to match the section line.
label.translation: Select a mesh body, select a plane, then adjust the location of the section line. Edit the sketch and use the Fit Curves To Mesh Section command to create sketch geometry to match the section line.

label.devLabel: Create a series of mesh section sketches to reverse-engineer complex mesh bodies. Edit each section sketch and use the Fit Curves To Mesh Section command to generate a series of sketch profiles. You can use the sketch profiles to create parametric solid and surface bodies to recreate the design.
label.translation: Create a series of mesh section sketches to reverse-engineer complex mesh bodies. Edit each section sketch and use the Fit Curves To Mesh Section command to generate a series of sketch profiles. You can use the sketch profiles to create parametric solid and surface bodies to recreate the design.

label.devLabel: Create Mesh Section Sketch Information
Uses a plane to trim or split a mesh body.
label.translation: Uses a plane to trim or split a mesh body.

label.devLabel: Select a mesh body, then select and position the cutting plane. The cut can trim the body, split the body into multiple bodies, or split the faces only. For the Trim and Split Body cut types, select a fill type to generate watertight bodies.
label.translation: Select a mesh body, then select and position the cutting plane. The cut can trim the body, split the body into multiple bodies, or split the faces only. For the Trim and Split Body cut types, select a fill type to generate watertight bodies.

label.devLabel: Adjust the Fill Type to either leave a mesh open or close the mesh body after you cut it. You can fill the voids that the cut plane leaves behind with either uniform or minimal mesh faces.
label.translation: Adjust the Fill Type to either leave a mesh open or close the mesh body after you cut it. You can fill the voids that the cut plane leaves behind with either uniform or minimal mesh faces.

label.devLabel: Use the Plane Cut command to slice a mesh body along a plane and either trim away one side of the body, split the mesh body into two separate bodies, or slice the mesh faces but leave the mesh body whole.
label.translation: Use the Plane Cut command to slice a mesh body along a plane and either trim away one side of the body, split the mesh body into two separate bodies, or slice the mesh faces but leave the mesh body whole.

label.devLabel: Plane Cut Information
Reduces the number of faces on a mesh body to minimize complexity.
label.translation: Reduces the number of faces on a mesh body to minimize complexity.

label.devLabel: Select a mesh body or face groups, select a reduction target, then adjust the settings to reduce the number of mesh faces.
label.translation: Select a mesh body or face groups, select a reduction target, then adjust the settings to reduce the number of mesh faces.

label.devLabel: Use the Adaptive remesh type to preserve details. Use the Uniform remesh type to keep face sizes relatively even.
label.translation: Use the Adaptive remesh type to preserve details. Use the Uniform remesh type to keep face sizes relatively even.

label.devLabel: Use the Tolerance reduction type to reduce complexity and improve computational performance while working with the mesh. The Tolerance reduction type merges faces while remaining within a maximum deviation from the original mesh shape.
label.translation: Use the Tolerance reduction type to reduce complexity and improve computational performance while working with the mesh. The Tolerance reduction type merges faces while remaining within a maximum deviation from the original mesh shape.

label.devLabel: Reduce Information
Refines or coarsens faces on a mesh body or face groups.
label.translation: Refines or coarsens faces on a mesh body or face groups.

label.devLabel: Select a mesh body or face groups on a mesh body, then adjust the settings to regenerate the mesh faces.
label.translation: Select a mesh body or face groups on a mesh body, then adjust the settings to regenerate the mesh faces.

label.devLabel: Use the Adaptive remesh type to preserve details. Use the Uniform remesh type to keep face sizes relatively even.
label.translation: Use the Adaptive remesh type to preserve details. Use the Uniform remesh type to keep face sizes relatively even.

label.devLabel: Remesh Information
Remove meshes

Select the mesh bodies to be removed. For every mesh which is removed, a feature appears in the timeline. The removal can be, in contrast to delete, be undone and meshes can be restored parametrically.
label.translation: Select the mesh bodies to be removed. For every mesh which is removed, a feature appears in the timeline. The removal can be, in contrast to delete, be undone and meshes can be restored parametrically.

label.devLabel: Repairs a mesh body to prepare it for further design and manufacturing operations.
label.translation: Repairs a mesh body to prepare it for further design and manufacturing operations.

label.devLabel: Select a mesh body to repair, then select a repair type. For the Rebuild repair type, select a rebuild type, then adjust density and offset.
label.translation: Select a mesh body to repair, then select a repair type. For the Rebuild repair type, select a rebuild type, then adjust density and offset.

label.devLabel: Use the Repair command to fix errors in a mesh body to prepare it for further design and manufacturing operations. Errors may include holes in the mesh body or suboptimal arrangement, orientation, or intersection of triangles in the mesh body.
label.translation: Use the Repair command to fix errors in a mesh body to prepare it for further design and manufacturing operations. Errors may include holes in the mesh body or suboptimal arrangement, orientation, or intersection of triangles in the mesh body.

label.devLabel: Use the Close Holes or Stitch and Remove repair types for faster results and fewer changes to the mesh body. For more complex repairs, use the Wrap or Rebuild repair types, but keep in mind that these will take longer to compute and will make more significant changes to the mesh body.
label.translation: Use the Close Holes or Stitch and Remove repair types for faster results and fewer changes to the mesh body. For more complex repairs, use the Wrap or Rebuild repair types, but keep in mind that these will take longer to compute and will make more significant changes to the mesh body.

label.devLabel: Repair Information
Reverses the normal direction of selected faces on a mesh body.
label.translation: Reverses the normal direction of selected faces on a mesh body.

label.devLabel: Select faces on a mesh body to reverse their normal direction.
label.translation: Select faces on a mesh body to reverse their normal direction.

label.devLabel: Some faces on imported mesh bodies may be oriented incorrectly, and the Reverse Normal command lets you orient those faces correctly in a targeted way.
label.translation: Some faces on imported mesh bodies may be oriented incorrectly, and the Reverse Normal command lets you orient those faces correctly in a targeted way.

label.devLabel: Reverse Normal Information
Scales mesh bodies from a reference point.
label.translation: Scales mesh bodies from a reference point.

label.devLabel: Select mesh bodies, select a reference point to scale from and a scale type, then specify the scale factor to scale the mesh bodies.
label.translation: Select mesh bodies, select a reference point to scale from and a scale type, then specify the scale factor to scale the mesh bodies.

label.devLabel: Select multiple mesh bodies to scale them all at once from a common reference point.
label.translation: Select multiple mesh bodies to scale them all at once from a common reference point.

label.devLabel: Use the Nonuniform scale type to scale mesh bodies by a different scale factor along the X, Y, and Z axes.
label.translation: Use the Nonuniform scale type to scale mesh bodies by a different scale factor along the X, Y, and Z axes.

label.devLabel: Scale Mesh Information
Smooths the boundary edges of a mesh body.
label.translation: Smooths the boundary edges of a mesh body.

label.devLabel: Select a mesh body or face groups to smooth the boundary edges, improving mesh quality near open boundaries.
label.translation: Select a mesh body or face groups to smooth the boundary edges, improving mesh quality near open boundaries.

label.devLabel: Smooth Boundary optimizes the mesh topology near boundary edges without significantly changing the overall shape.
label.translation: Smooth Boundary optimizes the mesh topology near boundary edges without significantly changing the overall shape.

label.devLabel: Use Smooth Boundary to improve mesh quality near open edges and boundary regions.
label.translation: Use Smooth Boundary to improve mesh quality near open edges and boundary regions.

label.devLabel: Smooth Boundary Information
Smooths rough or creased regions on a mesh body.
label.translation: Smooths rough or creased regions on a mesh body.

label.devLabel: Select a mesh body or face groups, select a smoothing type, then adjust the smoothness and scale to smooth rough or creased regions.
label.translation: Select a mesh body or face groups, select a smoothing type, then adjust the smoothness and scale to smooth rough or creased regions.

label.devLabel: Use the Smooth command to soften rough areas or sharp creases on a mesh body.
label.translation: Use the Smooth command to soften rough areas or sharp creases on a mesh body.

label.devLabel: Specify Smoothness on a scale from 0-1.00, where 0 applies minimal smoothing effects to the mesh body and 1.00 applies maximum smoothing effects.
label.translation: Specify Smoothness on a scale from 0-1.00, where 0 applies minimal smoothing effects to the mesh body and 1.00 applies maximum smoothing effects.

label.devLabel: Smooth Information
Converts an existing solid or surface body into a mesh body.
label.translation: Converts an existing solid or surface body into a mesh body.

label.devLabel: Select the solid or surface body to tessellate, then adjust the mesh refinement settings to convert the body to a mesh body.
label.translation: Select the solid or surface body to tessellate, then adjust the mesh refinement settings to convert the body to a mesh body.

label.devLabel: Start with one of the Refinement presets, then customize the refinement settings to fine-tune the result before you complete the tessellation.
label.translation: Start with one of the Refinement presets, then customize the refinement settings to fine-tune the result before you complete the tessellation.

label.devLabel: Check the Preview setting to see what the new mesh body will look like as you adjust the Refinement Settings.
label.translation: Check the Preview setting to see what the new mesh body will look like as you adjust the Refinement Settings.

label.devLabel: Tesselate Information
Uses an image to add surface texture to a mesh body.
label.translation: Uses an image to add surface texture to a mesh body.

label.devLabel: Select faces, face groups, or a mesh body to add texture to and choose an image to use for the texture. Specify the extrude type and distance then adjust the image scale and placement.
label.translation: Select faces, face groups, or a mesh body to add texture to and choose an image to use for the texture. Specify the extrude type and distance then adjust the image scale and placement.

label.devLabel: Optionally, repeat the texture in a grid pattern across the selected geometry.
label.translation: Optionally, repeat the texture in a grid pattern across the selected geometry.

label.devLabel: Images with blended gradients create smoother textures while pure black-and-white images create textures with steep extrudes.
label.translation: Images with blended gradients create smoother textures while pure black-and-white images create textures with steep extrudes.

label.devLabel: Black and White or grayscale images provide the most predictable results. Color images are converted to grayscale and the extrusion height depends on the shades of gray.
label.translation: Black and White or grayscale images provide the most predictable results. Color images are converted to grayscale and the extrusion height depends on the shades of gray.

label.devLabel: Texture Extrude Information
Converts a mesh body or face groups with triangular faces to a mesh body or face groups with quad faces.
label.translation: Converts a mesh body or face groups with triangular faces to a mesh body or face groups with quad faces.

label.devLabel: Select a mesh body or face groups, select an output type, then adjust the settings to convert from triangular to quad faces.
label.translation: Select a mesh body or face groups, select an output type, then adjust the settings to convert from triangular to quad faces.

label.devLabel: Selection Priority
Finish direct editing
By Accuracy
Creates a solid or surface body that matches the shape of the original mesh body more or less accurately, based on the resolution you select.
label.translation:
Управляет допусками для изменения геометрии эскиза.
Альтернативно, настройте каждый допуск индивидуально ниже.

label.devLabel: By Face Number
Creates solid or surface body with a specific number of faces.
Specify the maximum percentage deviation of the reduced mesh from the original mesh shape.
label.translation: Разделить целевые грани путем расширения выбранных граней, рабочих плоскостей или выдавливания выбранных эскизов

label.devLabel: Face Count
Reduces mesh to a specific number of faces.
label.translation: Создать ограничивающий твердотельный модель для выбранных деталей
